methods.name: Power of the one-sample, two-sample and paired t test, solved for any one parameter
methods.reference: stats::power.t.test(n, delta, sd, sig.level, power, type, alternative, strict, tol)
quantities: power, n, delta, sd, sig.level for type two.sample / one.sample / paired x alternative two.sided / one.sided (tol 1e-12)
R's default tol (2^-13) n and sd
methods.tolerance: power 1e-10 relative (+1e-14), roots 1e-9 relative (+1e-12); R's default-tolerance roots within 2 tol absolute

deviations.quantity: power_t_test (the Tier 0 function), one-sided power at a negative delta
deviations.note: the Tier 0 function tests the one-sided alternative in the direction of delta (the power of |delta|); R and power_t_test_with test the upper tail whatever the sign of delta (power 1.0e-6 at n = 20, delta = -1). Not compared with R; power_t_test_with is.

methods.name: Power of the two-sample proportion test, solved for any one parameter
methods.reference: stats::power.prop.test(n, p1, p2, sig.level, power, alternative, strict, tol)
quantities: power, n, p1, p2, sig.level for both alternatives (tol 1e-12)
n = 100, 0.3 vs 0.5 power; n for power 0.8 at tol 1e-12 and R's default tol
methods.tolerance: power 1e-10 relative (+1e-14), roots 1e-9 relative (+1e-12); R's default-tolerance roots within 2 tol absolute

methods.name: Power of the balanced one-way ANOVA, solved for any one parameter
methods.reference: stats::power.anova.test(groups, n, between.var, within.var, sig.level, power); solved values re-solved with uniroot(tol = 1e-12) over R's intervals
quantities: n, groups, between.var, within.var, sig.level (tol 1e-12 and R's default)
groups 3, n 20, between 0.25: power and n (STAT-34)
methods.tolerance: power 1e-10 relative (+1e-14), roots 1e-9 relative (+1e-12); R's default-tolerance roots within 2 tol absolute

methods.name: Noncentral t and F distribution functions (Lenth's AS 243 and AS 226 series with Frick's start)
methods.reference: stats::pt(q, df, ncp, lower.tail); stats::pf(q, df1, df2, ncp, lower.tail)
quantities: pt at 16 points (one per pnt.c branch: series, normal approximation, df > 4e5, t < 0 with ncp > 40, ncp = 0, fractional df)
pf at 10 points (pnbeta series, df2 > 1e8 noncentral chi-square, x = 0, ncp = 0, large ncp)
methods.tolerance: 1e-12 relative + 1e-14 absolute (the published series (AS 243; AS 226 + R84) with R's constants; f64)

methods.name: Log-linear models by iterative proportional fitting, non-decomposable models
methods.reference: stats::loglin(table, margin, eps, iter, fit = TRUE) (AS 51)
quantities: G2, X2, df, p-values, fitted table (eps 1e-12)
fitted tables and p-values at eps 1e-12 and 1e-10; non-convergence reported
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 180-652: statistics and fit 1e-6 relative, p 1e-6 + 1e-12, df exact; iterations not pinned
